messages.subject: How to pass information from the server.R to the ui.R?
parts:
My example app - http://glimmer.rstudio.com/awegro/RunningChase/ - takes the race results and plots them using ggplot2.

https://github.com/awegro/ShinyApps

One of the hacks that I have is that in order to display the list of company names - I've had to load the data into both the ui.R and server.R files. Is there a way for me to pass the list of company names from the server.R file into the ui.R?

Thanks

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to pass information from the server.R to the ui.R?
parts:
Create a third file named global.R and assign the data to a variable there. This creates values in the global environment, so they're accessible from both ui.R and server.R.

I don't think we documented this anywhere. I might need to add a page to the tutorial called "Other random features"...

messages.author: 33dc9c6d026ee296
messages.subject: Re: How to pass information from the server.R to the ui.R?
parts:
Make the server render your tabset panel, like this:

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      textInput(inputId = "tab1title", value = "First", label = "Tab 1 Title"),
      textInput(inputId = "tab2title", value = "Second", label = "Tab 2 Title")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      uiOutput("tabsetpanel")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$tabsetpanel <- renderUI({
    tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel(title = input$tab1title),
      tabPanel(title = input$tab2title)
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui,server)
